test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What distinguishes a bank from other financial institutions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Accepting Deposits.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary functions of banks are, **Accepting Deposits, Providing Loans, and Facilitating Payments**.
 
• Banks can be of many types such as **Commercial banks, Investment banks, Retail banks, and Central banks**.
 
• India's first Bank was the **Bank of Hindustan, established in 1770 in Calcutta.**
 
• **RBI was established on April 1, 1935**. It was created by the Reserve Bank of India Act 1934.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Financial Institutions other than Banks are **Insurance Companies, Investment Firms, Mutual Funds, Pension Funds etc.**
